Adding these equations, we obtain (a + c ) – (b + d) = (a – b) + (c – d) = k1n + k2n = (k1 + k2) n or, as a congruent statement a + c ≡ b + d (mod n) Now, note that ac = (b + k1n)(d + k2n) = bd + (bk2 + dk1 + k1k2n )n Because bk2 + dk1 + k1k2n is an integer, this says that ac – bd is divisible by n, hence ac ≡ bd (mod n)
